scripts.title: tarekscripter flying script(v2 really big update!)
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local character, humanoid, root
local animTrackConnection, diedConnection

local function stopAllAnimations()
    if humanoid then
        for _, track in pairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            track:Stop(0)
        end
    end
end

local function resetJoints()
    if character then
        for _, v in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            -- تجنب تعديل مفاصل الأدوات لضمان عملها بشكل طبيعي أثناء الطيران
            if v:IsA("Motor6D") and v.Name ~= "RightGrip" then
                v.Transform = CFrame.new()
            end
        end
    end
end

local flying = false
local flySpeed = 1
local bv, bg

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if bv then bv:Destroy(); bv = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy(); bg = nil end
    if animTrackConnection then animTrackConnection:Disconnect(); animTrackConnection = nil end
    
    if humanoid then 
        humanoid.PlatformStand = false 
        local anim = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate") 
        if anim then anim.Disabled = false end 
    end
    
    local mainGui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TarekScripter_Fly")
    if mainGui then
        local frame = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
        if frame then
            local onofBtn = frame:FindFirstChild("onof")
            if onofBtn then onofBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0) end
        end
    end
end

local function updateVars(newChar)
    stopFly()
    character = newChar
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if diedConnection then diedConnection:Disconnect() end
    diedConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        stopFly()
    end)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then updateVars(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateVars)

local main = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
main.Name = "TarekScripter_Fly"
main.ResetOnSpawn = false
main.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame", main)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(163, 255, 137)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.38, 0)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 57)
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true

local function createBtn(name, text, pos, size, color)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", Frame)
    b.Name = name
    b.Text = text
    b.Position = pos
    b.Size = size
    b.BackgroundColor3 = color
    b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
    b.TextSize = 14
    b.TextScaled = true
    return b
end

local adminSim = createBtn("adminSim", "محاكاه ادمن", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 57), Color3.fromRGB(79, 255, 152))
local adminEnabled = false

local onof = createBtn("onof", "fly", UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.49, 0), UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 28), Color3.fromRGB(255, 249, 74))
local plus = createBtn("plus", "+", UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 28), Color3.fromRGB(133, 145, 255))
local mine = createBtn("mine", "-", UDim2.new(0.23, 0, 0.49, 0), UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 29), Color3.fromRGB(123, 255, 247))

local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", Frame)
TextLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(242, 60, 255)
TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.47, 0, 0, 0)
TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 28)
TextLabel.Text = "TarekScripter"
TextLabel.TextScaled = true

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", Frame)
speedLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 0)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.47, 0, 0.49, 0)
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 28)
speedLabel.Text = "1"
speedLabel.TextScaled = true

local closebutton = createBtn("Close", "X", UDim2.new(0, 0, -1, 27), UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 28), Color3.fromRGB(225, 25, 0))
local mini = createBtn("mini", "-", UDim2.new(0, 44, -1, 27), UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 28), Color3.fromRGB(192, 150, 230))

local keybindBtn = createBtn("keybindBtn", "key Z", UDim2.new(0.89, 0, -1, 27), UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 28), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0))

local infoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", Frame)
infoLabel.Name = "infoLabel"
infoLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100)
infoLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1.18, 0, -1, 27)
infoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 28)
infoLabel.Text = "F1 to change"
infoLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
infoLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
infoLabel.TextScaled = true

local flyKey = Enum.KeyCode.Z
local listeningForKey = false

local blockedKeys = {
    [Enum.KeyCode.W] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.A] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.S] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.D] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.One] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Two] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Three] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Four] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.Five] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Six] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.F1] = true,
}

local currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local lastMoveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local stopTime = 0

adminSim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    adminEnabled = not adminEnabled
    adminSim.BackgroundColor3 = adminEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(79, 255, 152)
end)

local function startFly()
    if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    flying = true
    currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    onof.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
    
    local anim = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if anim then anim.Disabled = true end
    
    stopAllAnimations()
    resetJoints()
    
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", root)
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bg.CFrame = root.CFrame
    
    if adminEnabled then
        local bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition", root)
        bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
        bp.D = 750; bp.P = 5000
        bp.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
        task.delay(0.5, function() if bp then bp:Destroy() end end)
    end
end

local function toggleFly()
    if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
end

onof.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

local function startKeyListening()
    listeningForKey = true
    keybindBtn.Text = "chng key:"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
end

keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startKeyListening)

local inputConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end

    if listeningForKey then
        if not blockedKeys[input.KeyCode] then
            flyKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "key " .. input.KeyCode.Name
            listeningForKey = false
            keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
        end
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        startKeyListening()
        return
    end

    if gameProcessed then return end

    if flyKey and input.KeyCode == flyKey then
        toggleFly()
    end
end)

plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    flySpeed = flySpeed + 1 
    speedLabel.Text = tostring(flySpeed) 
end)

mine.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    if flySpeed > 1 then 
        flySpeed = flySpeed - 1 
        speedLabel.Text = tostring(flySpeed) 
    end 
end)

local PlayerModule = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule"))
local Controls = PlayerModule:GetControls()

local renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if flying and root and bv and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveVector = Controls:GetMoveVector()
        
        if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
            local forward = cam.CFrame.LookVector * -moveVector.Z
            local side = cam.CFrame.RightVector * moveVector.X
            local targetVelocity = (forward + side).Unit * (flySpeed * 60)
            
            if adminEnabled then
                currentVelocity = currentVelocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, math.clamp(deltaTime * 10, 0, 1))
            else
                currentVelocity = targetVelocity
            end
            
            lastMoveDir = currentVelocity
            stopTime = os.clock()
        else
            if adminEnabled then
                local elapsed = os.clock() - stopTime
                local glideDuration = 0.4
                
                if elapsed < glideDuration then
                    local alpha = 1 - (elapsed / glideDuration)
                    currentVelocity = lastMoveDir * (alpha * alpha)
                else
                    currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
            else
                currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
        end
        
        bv.Velocity = currentVelocity
        if bg then bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame end
        if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
    end
end)

closebutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    stopFly()
    if inputConnection then inputConnection:Disconnect() end
    if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect() end
    if diedConnection then diedConnection:Disconnect() end
    main:Destroy() 
end)

local isMini = false
mini.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMini = not isMini
    for _, v in pairs(Frame:GetChildren()) do 
        if v ~= mini and v ~= closebutton then 
            v.Visible = not isMini 
        end 
    end
    Frame.BackgroundTransparency = isMini and 1 or 0
    mini.Text = isMini and "+" or "-"
end)
